name: deed-page-mcp-server
title: deed.page
summary: Publish HTML pages and static sites written by an agent to permanent public HTTPS URLs, with no account needed for the first publish.
description: deed.page is static web hosting for AI agents. Its remote MCP server lets an agent publish files it wrote (a single HTML page, a report, a prototype or a small static site) to a permanent HTTPS URL at a slug it chooses, then update that page in place, check whether a slug is live, list its versions and restore an earlier one, or delete the site. The first publish needs no account: it returns an owner token, which the client keeps privately and sends as a Bearer token for later updates, listing and deletion. Everything published is public, so agents should not publish secrets or private data. Free and paid plans are described in the documentation.

useCases.name: Share agent output as a web page
useCases.description: Turn a report, summary, dashboard or document the agent generated as HTML into a public URL the user can open and share, instead of pasting long output into chat.

useCases.name: Publish prototypes and small static sites
useCases.description: Publish several files at once (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images) or a single-page app, and update the same URL as the work changes. Larger sites use a manifest upload so unchanged files are not sent again.

useCases.name: Versioned updates
useCases.description: Each publish creates a new version of the slug. The agent can check what is live, list retained versions and restore an earlier one without uploading the files again.

useCases.name: Temporary previews
useCases.description: Set an expiry on a publish to share a preview link that removes itself, or delete a site when it is no longer needed.

deedpageBearer.description: Optional for a first publish. The owner token it returns is sent as a Bearer token to update, list, version or delete the owner's sites.
